name: human_01_one_probe_rim_marine
story: Saturday maintenance on a 300 L reef. Owner lifts probe 1 out of the water to clean the glass and forgets it hanging on the rim; probes 0 and 2 stay in. It stays out ~14 h until the next morning, then gets put back.

events.note: Probe 1 forgotten on the rim for 14 h; reads room temp (~21 C) vs 25 C for the other two
Owner notices and puts the probe back in the water

expect: Within seconds of 16 h the probe-1 reading falls (3 min lag) and the rate filter (>0.05 C/s) and/or the >0.4 C disagreement exclude it: sensorFault, fail-safe, BOTH loads powered, each governed by its internal thermostat only.
A probe fault alarm is raised after the 30 s debounce (MQTT/HA). No overtemp/undertemp alarm (silent in fail-safe).
Tank must stay roughly 24-26.5 C for the 14 h (heater internal 24.5, chiller internal 26); fish never leave ideal band by more than ~0.5 C. No heater/chiller fight (heater set < chiller set).

BUG if firmware keeps regulating with the 2 good probes as if healthy (2 agreeing probes are not enough, no third corroborating) or uses the median including the 21 C probe (would run heater hard and overheat toward internalSet only, but would be wrongly trusted).

After the probe returns (~30 h): fail-safe exit is rechecked every 30 s and after the jump lockout (5 min) the probe is re-seeded; normal control resumes and the probe alarm clears. BUG if fail-safe sticks past ~6 min, or if it chatters.
